name: ouroboros-mcp
description: Project knowledge base and backlog management. Persist decisions, facts, and notes across conversations. Track work items, plans, and project configuration.

ouroboros.instructions: Read/write axis: reads (get/search) require domain (kb|backlog); writes are kb (KB entries) and backlog (items). Project/plan/config/delete/export/import are CLI-only (run `ouroboros <cmd> --help`). get and search return summaries by default — pass verbose: true only when full content is needed. kb accepts an optional id to update an existing entry in place instead of creating a duplicate.
